subject: Fighter's Ring
text: The Fighter's Ring is located on the lowest floor of the Mountain Cave south of Garinham, with a recommended level of at least 7.

evidence.quote: The Fighter's Ring is located on the lowest floor in the Mountain Cave south of Garinham. A level of 7 is recommended at the very least.

subject: Fighter's Ring
text: To reach the Fighter's Ring, on B1F go right instead of taking the northwest stairs and follow the first path down to the staircase, then on B2F go up and follow the path left to two chests.

evidence.quote:
To get as quick as possible to this chest, you need to:

- B1F: Go up and to the north-west to find a staircase. Don't go down here, and instead go to the right, then the first path down and follow the path to the staircase.
- B2F: Go up as soon as you can, then continue the path to the left and you will find two chests at the end, with one containing the Fighter's Ring.

subject: Death Necklace
text: The Death Necklace appears randomly in a chest on the lowest floor of the Mountain Cave south of Garinham, requiring multiple trips in and out of the dungeon until found.

evidence.quote: The Death Necklace is also located on the lowest floor in the Mountain Cave south of Garinham, but there is a catch: this one appears randomly in a chest. You will have to go down to the chest and then out of the dungeon again multiple times to get this item.

subject: Death Necklace
text: On B2F of the Mountain Cave, heading to the far southwest and up leads to a solitary chest containing either ~100 gold or the Death Necklace.

evidence.quote: - B2F: Go down as soon as you can and make your way to the very south-west of the map, then up until you see a singular chest. This is the one that will either have ~100 gold, or the necklace.

subject: Fairy Flute
text: The Fairy Flute is found in Kol by standing south of the open air bath, walking four squares south, and searching.

evidence.quote: What you need to do is go to Kol and walk up to the open air bath. Stand to the south of it, walk four squares south, and search. You will there find the Fairy Flute.

subject: NPC
text: An NPC in Rimuldar gives the location of the Fairy Flute, though speaking to him is not required to find it.

evidence.quote: An NPC in Rimuldar will tell you about the location, but you don't need to talk to him to find this item.

subject: Cursed Belt
text: The Cursed Belt is located on the bottom floor of Garin's Grave, with a recommended level of at least 13, two Magic Keys, and a torch or Illuminate spell.

evidence.quote: The Cursed Belt is in Garin's Grave, on the bottom floor, which is the same dungeon as where you get the Silver Harp so tackling these both at once is recommended. A level of 13 is recommended at the very least. You will also need two Magic Keys and a torch or two or the Illuminate spell.

subject: Cursed Belt
text: To reach the Cursed Belt, open the right door on B1F to reach the central stairs, take either the northwest or southeast stairs on B2F, and open the chest in the northwest of B3F.

evidence.quote: - B1F:  Open the door on the right, then make your way to the middle of the screen where the only staircase is....- B2F: Take either the staircase located in the north-west, or in the south-east....- B3F: Make your way to the north-west of this map, where you will find a chest with the Cursed Belt.

subject: Silver Shield
text: The Silver Shield must be bought for 14,800 gold in Cantlin.

evidence.quote: Although this achievement says to find the Silver Shield, what you need to do is buy it for 14,800 gold in Cantlin.

subject: Axe Knight
text: In Hauksness, stepping on the square with trees to the right of two swamp tiles triggers an encounter with the Axe Knight guarding Erdrick's Armor.

evidence.quote: In this destroyed city, you want to get to the square with trees that is to the right of two swamp tiles, on the right side of the city. You know you will be at the correct square when you are attacked by an Axe Knight defending it.

subject: Erdrick's Armor
text: A level of around 17 is recommended against the Axe Knight, after which searching the square yields Erdrick's Armour.

evidence.quote: This is a fairly strong enemy, so be prepared and have a level of around 17 when you attempt this. Once the Axe Knight is dead, search the square and you will find Erdrick's Armour.

subject: Erdrick's Sword
text: Erdrick's Sword is located in Charlock Castle, requiring the Rainbow Bridge to be built and a recommended level of around 18 or higher.

evidence.quote: Erdrick's Sword is located in Charlock Castle, the final dungeon. Before you go here, you need to have finished building the Rainbow Bridge, and be at a level of around 18 or higher.

subject: Erdrick's Sword
text: To reach Erdrick's Sword, take the stairs behind the throne on 0F, follow the single paths on B1F and B2F, turn left and up on B3F, and go to the top right of B4F to descend the stairs left of the staircase.

evidence.quote: - 0F: Find the staircase behind the throne and go down....- B1F/B2F: Follow these paths until the end, there is only one staircase to take for both....- B3F: Take the first path to the left, then up and keep following the path until the next shortcut....- B4F: Make your way to the top right of the map, then stand left of the staircase and go down....Once you have taken this staircase, just keep following the paths until you inevitably arrive at Erdrick's Sword.

subject: Blue Slime
text: The Blue Slime roams around Tantegel and is defeated to level up.

evidence.quote: This enemy roams around Tantegel and is pretty much required to level up. Just defeat one and the achievement is yours.

subject: Goldman
text: The Goldman is found south of Rimuldar, near and slightly above the shrine, and provides good money.

evidence.quote: This enemy is located only south of Rimuldar, near the shrine and slightly above of it. Keep running around here until you find one... and stay here for a while because it's good money.

subject: Wyvern
text: The Wyvern appears south of Rimuldar in the same location as the Goldman, and also roams outside of Hauksness.

evidence.quote: You will encounter the Wyvern at the same location as the Goldman, south of Rimuldar. If by some miracle you don't come across it, it also roams outside of Hauksness.

subject: Metal Slime
text: The Metal Slime is located southwest of Hauksness, possesses high defense and tends to run away, but becomes a guaranteed one-shot kill at level 24.

evidence.quote: The Metal Slime is located south-west of Hauksness, and is a tough enemy to kill thanks to its high defense and tendency to run away. You can either just keep running around there and hope you end up lucky, or wait until level 24 where it will be a guaranteed one-shot.
